## FAQs
- Q: Do you deliver the same day in Lahore? A: Yes, orders placed before 4 PM are delivered the same day within 2–5 hours across DHA, Gulberg, Model Town, Bahria Town, Johar Town, Cantt and other Lahore areas.
- Q: What are your prices? A: Bouquets start from Rs. 1,180. Roses, sunflowers, lilies, tulips, money bouquets and wedding décor range up to Rs. 35,000.
- Q: Do you deliver at midnight? A: Yes, a midnight surprise slot (11:30 PM–12:15 AM) is available for birthdays and anniversaries with advance booking.
- Q: How do I pay? A: Cash on Delivery, bank transfer, JazzCash and EasyPaisa.
- Q: Can I send flowers to Lahore from abroad? A: Yes — order on WhatsApp at +92 310 4225974 and pay by bank transfer; we deliver across Lahore with photo confirmation.
- Q: Do you have a physical shop? A: Lahore Bouquet is a delivery-based florist serving all of Lahore — order online or on WhatsApp.
